title: Oscar and the Undertow
author: Rosalind Crane
blurb: Oscar Galloway, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
